about: Official launch and brand films of AI, SaaS, developer-tool and tech brands, posted by the brands (YouTube, X). Each was checked to play with yt-dlp and looked at by poster. study: moves = made with motion design (study the craft); story = mostly people on camera (study how the product is revealed, not the moves). Add films only after checking they play and who posted them.

In this video, we'll showcase how Ramp combines the power of expense management, procurement, accounting automation, corporate cards, and more in one simple, scalable spend management solution.
